[LEXP.16.3] The companion-slot form `cursor.<agg>` is
syntactic sugar for `<agg>(cursor)` — both are equivalent
and legal in any expression position. Value-argument
aggregations (`count_of`, `contains`) have no companion-slot
form; use the expression form `count_of(cursor, value)` /
`contains(cursor, value)` exclusively. Full cursor resolution
at [LSER.6].
